name: Burst of Frost and Flame
body:
School evocation (cold, fire); Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 4, bloodrager 4, druid/hunter 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half (see text); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You shoot a spiraling couple of entwined rays from your crossed hands to your foes- one freezing, the other scorching. You can also split your hands and fire the two rays separately to two different enemies. Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 3d6 points of damage, plus 1d6 for each 2 caster levels beyond 7th (maximum 8d6 at 17th level). The rays must be aimed at targets within 30 feet of each other and fired simultaneously.
